notablePrerequisites:
Aeries Ouphes does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
A creature with flying is on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing it, targeting any creature with flying.
Aerie Ouphes' persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Aerie Ouphes enters the battlefield, triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Aerie Ouphes.
The +1/+1 counter and -1/-1 counter are removed as a state-based action.
Repeat any number of times.
Resolve all Aerie Ouphes abilities, dealing an arbitrarily high amount of damage to any number of flying creatures.
